prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1422; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient was struck while turning left at an intersection. Presenting symptoms included headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, and the reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of impact described. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm a concussion. No prior injury to the head or neck is known from the patient's history. Over the course of care the patient attended 17 visits, a somewhat longer course than is typical for an injury of this type, with gradual improvement in symptoms and graduated return to daily activities. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. The patient continues to be monitored, and further follow-up is planned as symptoms resolve.
